description: Table 2 is a single-panel rendered data table titled "Fitting parameters of the EIS curves of the LDSs", presenting the equivalent-circuit fitting results of electrochemical impedance spectroscopy for four Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steel (LDS) samples. The table has nine columns: the row header (sample) plus R_s (Ω·cm²), Q_1 (Ω⁻¹·cm⁻²·sⁿ), n_1, R_1 (Ω·cm²), Q_2 (Ω⁻¹·cm⁻²·sⁿ), n_2, R_2 (Ω·cm²) and R_p (Ω·cm²); units are printed in the header cells exactly as shown. Four sample rows are listed: S0, S950, S1050 and S1150 (solution-treatment temperatures in °C). Printed values are: S0 — R_s 6.55, Q_1 2.62 × 10⁻⁴, n_1 0.85, R_1 1216, Q_2 1.13 × 10⁻⁴, n_2 0.60, R_2 4820, R_p 6036; S950 — 6.80, 2.92 × 10⁻⁴, 0.84, 2092, 1.43 × 10⁻⁴, 0.66, 10394, 12486; S1050 — 6.52, 2.40 × 10⁻⁴, 0.86, 1261, 1.07 × 10⁻⁴, 0.59, 6753, 8014; S1150 — 6.87, 2.42 × 10⁻⁴, 0.85, 1036, 1.36 × 10⁻⁴, 0.58, 5956, 6992. R_s stays nearly constant (~6.5-6.9 Ω·cm²), whereas R_p peaks at S950 (12486 Ω·cm²), roughly double the S0 value, and decreases with further rising solution temperature. The table supplies the quantitative basis for the claim that S950 has the best corrosion resistance.

observations.observation: Table 2 reports R_s (Ω·cm²) values of 6.55 (S0), 6.80 (S950), 6.52 (S1050) and 6.87 (S1150), all within a narrow range near 6.5-6.9 Ω·cm².
The four samples in the table are labelled S0, S950, S1050 and S1150, corresponding to different solution-treatment temperatures.
R_p increases from S0 to S950 and then decreases progressively for S1050 and S1150, i.e. R_p is maximal for the S950 sample and lowest for S0 among the listed values.
The caption states that Table 2 gives the fitting parameters of the EIS curves of the LDSs.
The citing text states that the polarization resistance R_p = R_1 + R_2 is used to evaluate the corrosion resistance of materials.
The citing text states that the S950 sample exhibits the highest R_p (12486 Ω·cm²), approximately double that of the S0 sample (6036 Ω·cm²), matching the table values.
The citing text states that R_p values progressively decrease with increasing solution temperature.

The citing text states that the higher R_p of S950 is consistent with the Bode magnitude plots in Fig. 8b and with the potentiodynamic polarization results, demonstrating superior corrosion resistance of S950.

subfigures.description: A nine-column parameter table of EIS equivalent-circuit fitting results for samples S0, S950, S1050 and S1150, reporting R_s, Q_1, n_1, R_1, Q_2, n_2, R_2 and R_p with units Ω·cm² and Ω⁻¹·cm⁻²·sⁿ. All cells are legible.
